title: Effect of Mo on the morphology, microstructure and mechanical properties of NbTa0.5TiMo*x* refractory high entropy alloy fabricated by laser powder bed fusion using elemental mixed powders
process_description: prepared by laser powder bed fusion (L-PBF) with elemental mixed powders using 500W fiber laser, 20μm spot diameter, Argon protective atmosphere, 200°C preheated Ti substrate, 30μm layer thickness, 60μm hatch space, 500mm/s scanning speed, and 320W laser power
